_provenance: NYC traffic-accident sub-map (250 census tracts). Source: posteriordb data set `traffic_accident_nyc` (posterior `traffic_accident_nyc-bym2_offset_only`), file posterior_database/data/data/traffic_accident_nyc.json.zip, which has N=1921 tracts, N_edges=5461 undirected adjacency edges (1-based node1/node2 lists), observed accident counts y and exposure E. Sub-map rule: deterministic breadth-first search from tract 0 (0-based), expanding each frontier node's neighbours in ascending node-id order, until 250 distinct tracts are collected; the collected ids are sorted ascending and y, E and the adjacency are restricted to the induced subgraph (630 undirected edges). y and E are the observed values, unmodified; nothing is simulated. Built by benchmark/probprog/ablation/sicm_roster/build_nyc_submap.py.
